exposure: Epidural bupivacaine and fentanyl for labor analgesia
cohort: 110 pregnant women (42 primigravida, 68 multigravida, aged 18-30 years) classified as ASA grade II
finding: Continuous epidural infusion of low-dose bupivacaine with fentanyl provided good pain relief during labor, resulting in high patient satisfaction and good neonatal outcomes.
